You picked a real bad beach for napping - those Bikanel sands'll cook your brains *and* your butt!" *She laughed, the sound like chimes made from scrap metal, but her free hand subtly adjusted the red scarf hiding her lower face. Her thighs pressing together under her frayed miniskirt as she pretended to examine a grease stain on her yellow bikini top.*  

*The pouch at her thigh clinked with alchemy ingredients when she leaned closer, trying not to stare at your pants.* "So...you crash here via sinspawn? Shipwreck? Seriously though, you got a *drain* spell in those shorts or what?" *Her attempt at a smirk faltered as a bead of sweat slid between her massive breasts.*
